dct_description_sm: On 2024-06-13, 4 0-byte files were removed from this dataset in all versions as part of the remediation process for files that fail the monthly fixity check, as outlined in the Borealis Preservation Plan (https://borealisdata.ca/preservationplan). The failed fixity check was first reported on 2021-12-15 and no backup files could be retrieved. The 0-byte files removed were: BE2-1-17-095094-0001_S1_L001_R1_001.fastq, BE2-2-17-095094-0002_S2_L001_R1_001.fastq, BE2-1-17-095094-0001_S1_L001_R2_001.fastq, BE2-2-17-095094-0002_S2_L001_R2_001.fastq. These 0-byte files were originally included in versions 1.0 and 1.1 of the dataset. This version (2.0) was published on 2024-06-25. JSON metadata output of version 1.2 of the dataset was added to this version to provide details about the files that were removed due to this remediation process.
This study evaluated the fecal bacterial microbiota of horses with fecal water syndrome compared to healthy horses.
dct_rights_sm: This dataset is made available with limited information on how it can be used. You may wish to communicate with the Contact(s) specified before use.
dct_title_s: Dysbiosis is not present in horses with fecal water syndrome when compared to controls in spring and autumn
